svg.title: SimCLR architecture
svg.desc: Two augmented views pass through a shared encoder and MLP projection head. InfoNCE loss pulls positive pairs together and pushes all others apart. The projection head is discarded after training.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What augmentations are used in SimCLR?')
sendPrompt('What augmentations are used in SimCLR?')
sendPrompt('What does the BaseNetwork encoder look like?')
sendPrompt('Why does SimCLR use a projection head and then discard it?')
sendPrompt('How does InfoNCE loss work in SimCLR?')
sendPrompt('Why do we L2-normalise before computing cosine similarity?')
sendPrompt('Why is the projection head discarded after SimCLR training?')
